description: List hiring signals read from companies' own job boards, newest first: leadership openings, team build-outs, hiring surges and freezes, expansion into new countries and hard-to-fill roles. Each signal carries the roles behind it. Filter by type, function, seniority, company or a time window. Costs one credit per returned signal.

activeOnly.description: Only signals whose roles are still open.

countries.description: Headquarters country codes (ISO alpha-2, OR). Pass "unknown" to include companies with no country on file.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as pagination.nextCursor on the previous page.

domain.description: Company domain, e.g. stripe.com. Matches the company's primary domain or any domain it redirected from; a full URL works too.

eventType.description: Signal types. Canonical values: leadership_opening, founding_role, role_family_scaling, technology_hiring, team_buildout, hiring_surge, hiring_freeze, location_expansion, hard_to_fill, leadership_filled.

function.description: Job functions, e.g. sales or engineering. Canonical values: engineering, data, security, it, product, design, sales, marketing, customer_success, operations, finance, people, legal, research, healthcare, executive, other, all.

includeTotal.description: Also return pagination.total, the number of records matching these filters across all pages. Costs no credits.

limit.description: Maximum records to return (1-100). Each returned record costs one credit.

roleFamily.description: Role families, e.g. sales_development, revops, security. Canonical values: sales_development, sales, sales_engineering, revops, gtm_engineering, partnerships, marketing, demand_gen, product_marketing, content_brand, customer_success, support, software_engineering, hardware_engineering, infrastructure, security, data_engineering, data_analytics, ml_ai, product_management, design, recruiting, people, finance, legal, it, operations, science, production.

seniority.description: Seniority of a leadership opening, e.g. c_level, vp_level, head, director.

since.description: Return records announced on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD) or ISO-8601 timestamp.

technologies.description: Technologies named in the roles, e.g. snowflake, salesforce, kubernetes.

until.description: Return records announced on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive) or ISO-8601 timestamp.

name: hiring_signals
title: Find hiring signals
